title: Establish proactive SDK triage funnel & enterprise onboarding rubric for legacy languages and streaming token ergonomics
creator: Nora Patel
description:
Background: We continue to receive high-signal asks from enterprise customers for additional first-class SDKs (notably Go and Rust), clearer auth/token rotation patterns for long-lived streaming sessions, and pragmatic onboarding for regulated customers. Current intake is ad-hoc, causing duplicate requests, slow response times for enterprises, and unclear prioritization against existing SDK work.

Goal: Design and implement a proactive triage funnel and scoring rubric that routes SDK/client library requests into one of three operational lanes: Quick Win (docs + shim), Eng Backlog (spec + dev ticket), Enterprise Concierge (high-touch project). The funnel should automate scoring, capture necessary artifacts for security/compliance review, and produce a Linear ticket with pre-filled fields and a recommended lane and SLA.

Scope:
- Intake form and automation that creates Linear tickets with scoring metadata.
- Scoring rubric with weighted signals: revenue impact, regulatory requirement, integration complexity, frequency (signal), engineering estimate, and security surface area.
- Prescriptive guidance for streaming ergonomics (resumable streams, refresh-token patterns, handshake telemetry) and token-rotation examples for SDK maintainers.
- Playbook for Enterprise Concierge including onboarding checklist, compliance artifacts (KMS/HSM, audit log template), and dedicated SLO for delivery.
- Minimal implementation for two priority legacy languages: Go and Rust (prototype design + API ergonomics), and a doc-first shim for Java-based legacy integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form deployed (internal) that produces Linear ticket with key fields: language, customer, severity, regulatory flag, estimated sessions/month, link to customer request
Automated scoring algorithm implemented in intake that assigns lane: Quick Win / Eng Backlog / Enterprise Concierge
Scoring thresholds are documented and agreed by PM, Eng, and Security
Playbook created with checklists for Enterprise Concierge (onboarding steps, compliance artifacts list, SLAs) and linked from Console onboarding docs
Design proposals for Go and Rust SDK ergonomics reviewed (API surface, streaming handshake, token rotation) and approved by SDK owners
Two prototype PRs opened: one docs-first shim for Java, one minimal Go SDK streaming example demonstrating token rotation and resumable stream behavior
Telemetry hooks (client handshake events + session resume) defined and onboarded into telemetry backlog for infra to implement
